metadata.title: ज़मीन आदिवासी की मुआवज़ा सेठ को मिला | Adivasi looses land in Ahmedabad -Mumbai Corridor
metadata.description: The tribals do not want to oppose the road construction in Palghar district of Maharashtra. Tribals say that they support expressway construction, but compensation for their land should also be given. In fact, tribals have been cultivating the land for many generations. But in the records this land belongs to the businessmen who do not live here.
